source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Phantom Edges & Where to Find Them
source_excerpt:
There are 25 different Phantom Edges to acquire as you progress through Phantom Blade Zero . Most are dropped by the main story bosses, but some are tied to side quests and optional encounters. The game also has a tracker for weapons and Phantom Edges in each region, making it easier to identify anything you have missed.
You can upgrade Phantom Edges to level 10 without losing resources when switching, and even after level 10, you can recover your resources by using a Talisman. The table below includes Phantom Edge images and locations. Some may look different or have different names if they have been Soul Tempered.
Complete Quick Hand's Request and talk to Quick Hand Zhang.
Defeat Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple.
Gather all the Memory Flowers marked in this region to access a hidden area near the Temple of Butterflies, then defeat Dusk, the Puppeteer.
Defeat Yuzan, No. 3 Musician Puppet.
Defeat Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain.
Defeat You Loong, Leader of the Blackwater Crew.
Defeat Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear, also known as the Thunder Lancer.
Defeat Flame, the Mask-Bound Lion Dance Grandmaster, then meet Lei Dang at Jingyang Hall.
Complete Quick Hand's Request in Pangzhen and talk to him.
Defeat You Loong, the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader.
Defeat Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation.
Head northwest to find Old Man Gen, who will give you this Phantom Edge. You must complete his prior quests to trigger this encounter.
Defeat Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade.
Talk to Inanis in the depths after defeating Huangxing.
